application_type_full: Approval of details reserved by a condition (discharge)
description: Erection of first floor and second floor rear extension to provide one additional dwelling  and reconfiguration of existing dwelling at second floor to provide two x one bedroom dwellings and associated amenity space
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted ( Block plan; Existing ground floor layout; Existing first floor layout; Existing second floor layout; Existing roof  layout; Existing front and rear elevations; Existing side elevation; Existing streetview elevation; Proposed ground floor layout; Proposed first floor layout; Proposed second floor layout; Proposed roof plan; Proposed front and rear elevations; Proposed side elevation; Proposed streetview elevation; Planning Statement by Savills dated April 2020
(received on 01 May 2020).
Energy and Sustainability Statement by XCO2 dated 03/08/2020. Received: 03/08/2020.
 ) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8:00am  to 6:00pm on Mondays to Friday and 9 :00am to 1:00pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - a)	Works shall be carried out in accordance with the Energy Statement hereby approved. Prior to first occupation of the new dwellings, evidence (e.g. photographs, installation contracts and As-Built certificates under the National Calculation Method) shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority and approved in writing to show that the development has been constructed in accordance with the approved Energy Statement and any subsequent approved revisions. 
b)	Prior to occupation of the new houses suitable devices for the monitoring of the solar photovoltaic panels shall have been installed, and the monitored data shall be submitted automatically to a monitoring web-platform at daily intervals for a period of three years from the point of full operation.

Condition : 6 - Prior to occupation of the hereby approved development, evidence (schedule of fittings and manufacturers' literature) demonstrating that the development of that phase has been constructed to achieve an internal water consumption by the development not exceeding 105 litres/person/day in line with The Water Efficiency Calculator for new dwellings issued by the Ministry for Housing, Communities and Local Government, shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 8 - Prior to the occupation of development, details of the arrangements for the storing of waste and recycled materials, including plans and elevations of the means of enclosure shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.
The details shall include a statement or similar commitment detailing measures that would be taken to ensure that bins are stored within the building other than for collection and then returned to their store(s) promptly thereafter.
The approved details shall be fully implemented and made available for use before the first occupation of the development hereby approved and thereafter be maintained in accordance with the approved details in perpetuity.

Condition : 9 - Prior to occupation of the new dwellings, full details and specifications of hard and soft landscaping for the development, shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. Details shall include planting (including name of species and amount), boundary treatments, hard surfacing and functional services including drainage/manholes/external lighting).

Condition : 10 - No dwelling shall be occupied until arrangements have been agreed in writing with the local planning authority and put in place to ensure that, with the exception of disabled persons, no resident of the development shall obtain a resident's parking permit within any controlled parking zone (CPZ) which may be in force in the administrative district of the local planning authority at any time. 
These arrangements shall require the submission of the addresses of the approved flats, as agreed with the Street Naming and Numbering Authority, to be submitted to the Council for inclusion on their CPZ Permit exclusion list.
